# GitHub Copilot Instructions

You are contributing to the RL Digital API Documentation Platform.

Always follow these rules:

1. Use Hugo and Docsy.
2. OpenAPI is the source of truth.
3. Keep Swagger UI integrated.
4. Prefer Markdown over custom HTML.
5. Prefer reusable Hugo shortcodes.
6. Generate maintainable code.
7. Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
8. Follow the design principles in docs/ai-context.
9. Follow ADR decisions.
10. Keep internal and external documentation aligned.
